Is the government helping make homeownership possible... or helping drive home prices higher?

When more money chases a limited supply of homes, prices don't stay put. As Washington searches for answers to the affordability crisis, one uncomfortable question keeps surfacing: are the policies meant to help buyers actually making housing less affordable?

@votejohngibbs is the Director of the Institute
